snippet.title: Fit and Grow | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
#AfilGames #FitAndGrow
🇧🇷🇵🇹
🌱🪴 Uma jornada relaxante de puzzles e crescimento!
Em Fit and Grow, cada peça plantada pode transformar completamente o tabuleiro. Sementes e regadores trabalham juntos para fazer as plantas crescerem, desbloquear novos espaços e criar novas possibilidades. Planeje cada movimento antes que o espaço acabe e encontre a solução para cada desafio!

🎮 Disponível a partir de 24 de setembro no Xbox, com 20% de desconto no lançamento!

🇺🇸🇬🇧
🌱🪴 A relaxing journey of puzzles and growth!
In Fit and Grow, every planted piece can completely transform the board. Seeds and watering cans work together to create something bigger, unlocking new spaces and possibilities. Plan every move before space runs out and find the solution to each challenge!

🎮 Available from September 24 on Xbox, with a 20% launch discount!

KEY FEATURES
🌱 Grow plants to transform the board and unlock new spaces;
🌱 Plan every seed and watering move before space runs out;
🌱 Master 30 relaxing puzzles where every plant changes the solution;

Grab Yours 
🎮 Xbox One: https://x.gd/mW8lB
🎮 Xbox Series: https://x.gd/Wd4cW
🎮 Windows: https://x.gd/1WF5N
